title: AID Job Message
description: Triggers AI-generated code detection for a single submission. AID is stateless: all info provided in message, no DB access.

submission_id.description: PK of submissions table — included for logging/tracing context

file_url.description: MinIO pre-signed URL (TTL 6h) to download source code

language.description: Programming language for model routing. AID currently supports python, java, cpp. If language not supported, AID returns status=not_applicable.

trace_id.description: Cross-service tracing ID, generated by api
